## IMPULSE 0.4.0

This release turns the polished one-tap prototype into the first persistent IMPULSE campaign.

### Highlights

- 20 deterministic data-driven levels with escalating particle counts and completion targets.
- Level unlocking, next-level navigation, and a campaign picker showing locked/unlocked state and earned stars.
- Per-level scoring, one-to-three-star evaluation, best-score tracking, and total-star progress.
- Local AndroidX DataStore persistence for progression, selected level, best results, and Game Feel settings.
- Retrying a level recreates the same deterministic challenge instead of rerolling its seed.
- Result UX now includes score, earned stars, retry, and next-level actions.
- New unit and Android runtime coverage for catalog, scoring, progression, and campaign navigation.

IMPULSE remains fully offline with no account, analytics, ads, backend, cloud sync, or Android `INTERNET` permission.

Release artifacts are signed with the existing project release certificate and published with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub artifact attestations.
